en.name: Hun Dun
en.ability: Each night*, choose a player: they die. If you kill a Townsfolk neightbour this way, all good players except Travellers are poisoned until dusk.

revisions.v1: Each night*, choose a player: they die. If you kill a Townsfolk neightbour this way, all good players except Travellers are poisoned until dusk.

zh.name: 混沌
zh.ability:
每个夜晚*，你要选择一名玩家：他死亡。
如果你以这种方式杀死了一名与你邻近的镇民玩家，除旅行者外的所有善良玩家会中毒直到下个黄昏。
